entries.mechanism: UKMOD's Universal-Credit transition inside bho_uk (i_bho_noUC / i_bho_yesUC) treats this hypothetical single under-25 working-age renter as a new benefit claim, routes it to Universal Credit, and deterministically zeroes the legacy Housing Benefit award bho_s ("ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits"). The composed pipeline computes the full statutory maximum Housing Benefit — the eligible rent 6000.00/year (500.00/month x 12) with a nil HB means so the 65 per cent taper does not bite. Verified deterministic (identical zero across repeated runs) and unaffected by pinning the HB take-up rates to 1.0, so this is a UKMOD-side current-law caseload-routing behaviour, not an Axiom encoding gap.
